tactics: induction l with | nil => simp | cons a l ih => obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := a; simp [ih, hf]
have hfg : f = fun a b => g a.1 b := by funext a b; exact hf a.1 a.2 b
induction l with | nil => simp | cons a l ih => cases a; simp_all
induction l with | nil => rfl | cons a l ih => rcases a with ⟨v, hv⟩; simp only [List.foldrM_cons, List.unattach_cons, ih, hf]
